text.p: German insurer Volksfuersorge Holding AG said on Tuesday it planned to pay an unchanged dividend of 15 marks per 50 mark share for 1996.
The company said in a letter to shareholders its earnings developed well in 1996.
Volksfuersorge is majority-owned by Aachener und Muenchener Beteiligungs-Aktiengesellschaft AG.
Volksfuersorge said its life insurance subsidiary, Volksfuersorge Deutsche Lebensversicherung AG, achieved an 11 percent rise in gross earnings to 1.26 billion marks last year.
Its non-life subsidiary Volksfuersorge Deutsche Sachversicherung AG reported unchanged premium income of 1.19 billion marks last year due to a decline in premiums for motor vehicle insurance.
